about_item: INNOVATIVE BRUSH DESIGN: This outdoor dog bath attachment includes our patented rubber splash shield and bath hose attachment that keeps you dry as you groom and massage your dog. It's the ultimate choice in grooming comfort for both you and your pet.

PRESSURE CONTROL VALVE: This outdoor garden hose sprayer brush head comes with an adjustable water pressure valve. Even outside, you can control how fast you want the water to come out! Massage your dog and keep them calm with this hose nozzle attachment.

EASY FOR YOU & YOUR DOG: Baths are a great time for you and your dog to bond. Our massaging brush will feel great on your dog as you clean that messy fur. Make quick work of those dirty paws before moving inside. Whether a full bath is need or a quick touch up after a walk or romp, enjoy a stress-free and enjoyable bath time!

GREAT FOR ALL AGES: Ergonomic and easy to use, this garden hose sprayer brush leaves you with an extra hand free, so you can soap up and comfort your pet while bathing them. Bathe, brush, rinse, start and stop water with one hand. Plus, it's easy to use for all ages!

HIGH QUALITY: This outdoor grooming brush comes with the patented Wondurdog shower brush with patented splash shield and metal garden hose connector for a sturdy and leak-free connection. This dog bath brush is built for the outdoors (no plastic connectors here) so don't worry about its durability when outside.

summary.text: Customers find the dog wash nozzle easy to turn on and off, making bathing simpler, and appreciate its functionality, with one customer noting it works well for German Shepherds. The water control features receive positive feedback, with one mentioning it can be switched off and on with a thumb. While the nozzle is heavy-duty and prevents getting drenched during baths, some report issues with the hose connection being leaky. Customers disagree on how easy it is to hold while bathing their dogs.

authors_reviews.title: Bath time is way easier using this
authors_reviews.text: After using a regular hose end nozzle and spraying water everywhere I didn’t want to, using this sprayer is a joy. The on-off valve and the flow valve can be used one-handed and work great. It’s easy to control the spray when cleaning around the face which really helps. It seems kinda pricey, but after you use it you will be happy with your purchase. We have been using it for about a year now and it still functions like new.
authors_reviews.author: Rick

authors_reviews.title: Awkward Nozzle, Works As Advertised
authors_reviews.text: It's really well made, however the position of the spray head is very awkward. It makes it difficult to scrub in different orientations without accidently unscrewing it from the hose. If it was a straight barrel (like those detatchable kitchen faucet spray heads), it'd be much easier to use in all different orientations.Other than that, it does what it's designed to do. It gets water all the way down to their undercoat, and pulls away excess fur as you comb it along their coat. They also enjoy it more than the shower setting on the normal garden nozzle.If it didn't have that awkward nozzle head, it'd be perfect.

authors_reviews.title: Unusual use for this product
authors_reviews.text: I swim in my own pool at least twice a day, year-round (I live in South Florida, so don't hate me!!). I wanted a way to wash my hair after swimming without having to take a shower, so after researching the horrendously expensive outdoor shower equipment, I bought this dog shower hose attachment. It is terrific! I love the rubber "fingers" that massage my scalp, as well as the frugal use of water. The only downside is that I must use a separate water shut-off valve between the hose and the scrubber for those moments when changing hair products. The scrubber warns that leaving water pressure on for "an extended period of time" can cause leakage, and indeed that is true. So rather than using the very convenient shut-off slide that is on the scrubber itself, I instead use the shut-off valve to relieve pressure on the scrubber. Not a big deal, but slightly annoying. Other than that, though, this is a great solution to my desire for a quick shampoo.
authors_reviews.author: SMM
